summary: Eldest son of Justice Henry Tuthill and great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison; John's 1st cousin 10x removed.
bio: Henry Tuthill (1690–1775) was the eldest son of Justice Henry Tuthill (1665–1750) and Bethia Horton, a granddaughter of both William Wells and Barnabas Horton. He died on 1 September 1775. He was the grandfather of Anna Tuthill Symmes and so the great-grandfather of First Lady Anna Symmes Harrison. His father was a brother of John's ancestor John Tuthill Jr., which makes Henry John's 1st cousin 10x removed.
sources: [R4-S1] Lucy D. Akerly, The Tuthill Family of Tharston, Norfolk Co., England, and Southold, Suffolk Co., New York (1898) (archive.org full text), pp. 8-9 (secondary) https://archive.org/details/tuthillfamilyoft00aker
